definitions.explanation: The faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

examples.japanese: {記憶|きおく}があいまいです。
その{日|ひ}のことをよく{記憶|きおく}している。

notes:
{記憶|きおく} refers to memory as a cognitive faculty or the act of remembering.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {記憶|きおく}にある/ない: to have/not have in memory
- {記憶|きおく}を{失|うしな}う: to lose memory
- {記憶|きおく}から{消|け}す: to erase from memory
- {記憶|きおく}に{新|あたら}しい: fresh in one's memory
- {記憶|きおく}をたどる: to trace one's memory

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {記憶|きおく}{力|りょく}: memory ability
- {記憶|きおく}{喪失|そうしつ}: amnesia

CONTRAST:
- {思|おも}い{出|で}: memories (emotional, nostalgic)
- {覚|おぼ}える: to memorize, learn

As a suru verb: {記憶|きおく}する means to memorize or commit to memory.
